summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compiled standalone TikZ quadrilateral ABCD (version 1, best_version). Vertices A (top), B (bottom-right), C (bottom-left), D (left) were derived from line detection and bound to glyphs via bind_point_labels. Right-angle marks at C and A were verified by detect_right_angle_marker and drawn. The critic scored it 0.92 with checklist 1.0, all four labels present, and must_repair=false.
